url.description: A2A endpoint of the Case History Agent (agent-stack a2a/case-history-agent), scheme included
Base URL of the Core Banking MCP Server (agent-stack mcp/core-banking-mcp), scheme included. /mcp is appended by the transport setting
Base URL of the Screening MCP Server (agent-stack mcp/screening-mcp), scheme included. /mcp is appended by the transport setting
Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, scheme included, up to and including the version path (e.g. https://host/openai/v1)

apiKey.description: API key of the LLM endpoint. For a proxy fronted by Basic authentication this is base64(clientId:clientSecret)

hs256Secret.description: Shared secret (HS256) that signs the callers' JWTs. The sub claim becomes the conversation owner
